QUOTE: "It downgrades the verdict on any hit and publishes the hits as `unsearched_corpus_hits`, so the claim can be checked." and "`q.unsearched_corpora` ... derives the unread kinds by subtraction from the kinds the database actually holds."

WHY: The answer says the grade is chosen by a per-call query of which corpora search did not read (not by result shape), with strong wording downgraded when unread corpora hold matches.
